facts.fact: Kunal's father died at the end of summer, of a lung fever. Pritam told the Udai story at supper a week after the funeral; he took Kunal up the Kuhl ridge a month after the funeral, in autumn. S7: change F526's 'winter Kunal was nine' to autumn, and F540's 'spring' to end of summer.
The night-of-ch20 hut is a herders' summer hut on the scree above the Drum, a steep climb from the shore. It is not Dhanu's upper hut above the Mirror (F515). Corrects F543.
In the hut Ila unpicks her coat lining, moves the queen's letter into her pattu's hem and sews it in. She unties the rope for the night, then reties it on both wrists before Kunal's promise.

Before Kunal's 'ask nothing back' promise, Ila names both costs aloud: a broken promise strikes as a great lie, and each name may become a line on the crown's map. At dawn his fingertips chill when he begins to ask about the letter, and he stops.
